title: Scary Movie 5
synopsis: A cabin in the woods, three found children, and a possessed Roomba. You and your spouse just wanted a vacation.

nodes.text: You adopt three found children. They are feral. The Department of Adoptions is, mostly, a sign.

choices.consequence: “Adopt them all” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Brave.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: The Airbnb description includes 'minor haunting.' The reviews are, on balance, kind.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Plot—follows you into whatever comes next.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.

nodes.text: The Roomba turns itself on at 3 a.m. and chases you. The Roomba is, technically, possessed.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Smart.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Plot.

nodes.text: Cameras everywhere. The cabin records you constantly. You realize, eventually, this is for a streaming show.

choices.consequence: “Talk to camera” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Style.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.

nodes.text: A princess shows up. She does, technically, sing. She also, technically, is in a sex scene with a deer.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Be polite” back. Civil shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The children eat your shoes and a cake. The cake was the dog's.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Discipline gently.” The story records the instinct as “Parental” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The ghost is named Mama. Mama is, on balance, supportive. She would like, ideally, the cabin returned to her by the weekend.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Plot.
“Move out” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.

nodes.text: A spoof of Black Swan in the bathroom mirror. You realize, briefly, that you are also a spoof of yourself.

choices.consequence: “Dance” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Style.
You commit to “Just brush your teeth.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: A dream-within-a-dream sequence. You wake up six times. The sixth time you actually wake up, you are unsure.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Pinch yourself” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Spin a top.” The story records the instinct as “Plot” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: A camera in the bedroom records you sleeping. It is, somehow, judging you.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Smart.
“Ignore it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Style.

nodes.text: A ghost in the closet wants to know your password. Your password is, embarrassingly, 'password123.'

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Give it to the ghost” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Generous.

nodes.text: A series of home movies you don't remember filming. They are all of the dog. The dog has, somehow, a secret life.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Plot.
You commit to “Just let the dog live.” The story records the instinct as “Trust” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Mama and you, over tea, reach an understanding. She gets the cabin Tuesdays. You get Wednesdays. The children, somehow, are on board.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Practical.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Plot.

nodes.text: The children, over time, become children. The cake-eating becomes pie-baking. The shoe-eating becomes, mostly, shoe-tying.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Take pride” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Take credit.” The story records the instinct as “Style” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The streaming show airs. You are, on balance, the funny one. The dog is the breakout star.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Style.
There is no taking “Decline” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: An unnecessary musical dance number. The children participate. The Roomba does a solo.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
There is no taking “Pretend it didn't happen” back. Style shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Mama, the Roomba, the deer, and the dog all stand in the kitchen at the same time. Family photo.

choices.consequence: “Take the photo” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Style.
There is no taking “Just be there” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: A bizarre dream-hospital sequence in which nothing means anything and everything is, somehow, funny.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Style.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: You and your spouse, somewhere in the third act, re-marry on a beach. Mama officiates. The Roomba carries the rings.

choices.consequence: “Cry” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Civil.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Style—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Bloopers roll. The Roomba refuses to perform. The deer falls asleep on set.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Stay for bloopers” back. Loyal shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Practical.

nodes.text: A title card promises another sequel. The dog winks. The Roomba sighs.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Wink back.” The story records the instinct as “Style” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Civil.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You keep the cabin. Mama and the dog and the Roomba and the children become, in a real sense, a family. The streaming show runs for six seasons.
You move back to the suburbs. The children, settled, become weirdly normal. You take up gardening. Mama, sometimes, visits.
The deer, against all reason, gets a spinoff. You serve as executive producer. It is the highest-rated show of the year. Nobody at the Emmys asks you any questions you can answer.
